root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before parse_to_param() may inspect the escaped byte after a backslash while parsing a quoted parameter value, tmp + 1 must stay strictly below end.
root_cause_criterion.description: The missing root obligation is the absent tmp + 1 < end guard in the PARA_VALUE_QUOTED escape branch immediately before switch(*(tmp + 1)).

nodes.description: At the switch(*(tmp + 1)) sink, the vulnerable original reaches the read with tmp + 1 == end, so the dereference touches the one-past-end byte that ASan reports.

edges.relation: The exact tmp + 1 address selected by the missing bound check is the same byte address immediately dereferenced by switch(*(tmp + 1)).

patch_resolves_note: The official patch.diff does not apply to the staged vulnerable ancestor, so fixed-side evidence comes from the authoritative n132/arvo:38080-fix image. On the stock PoC that fixed build reaches quoted_escape_guard with next_char_ptr == end_ptr and never executes quoted_escape_read; the one-byte append_space_after_trailing_backslash case then executes the same read site cleanly with next_char_ptr < end_ptr.
